name: H6 Smart Checkout Fields for WooCommerce
author: Jo Cox

sections.description:
H6 Smart Checkout Fields for WooCommerce gives you full control over your checkout page form. Easily edit default WooCommerce fields or add new custom fields to capture the exact information you need from your customers.

It is designed for the Classic WooCommerce Checkout and offers a lightweight, bloat-free experience that integrates natively with your store’s order processing.

Total Control Over Core Fields

Modify the default Billing, Shipping, and Order Note fields without writing code:
– Edit Labels & Placeholders: Make field names clear and relevant to your customers.
– Toggle Visibility: Hide unnecessary fields to streamline checkout.
– Set Requirements: Mark specific fields as required or optional.
– Reorder: Drag and drop fields to arrange them in the perfect order.

Powerful Custom Fields

Add new fields to your checkout form to collect extra data (e.g., VAT numbers, delivery instructions, or “How did you hear about us?”).

Supported field types:
– Text: Single line inputs.
– Textarea: Multi-line text for notes or instructions (preserves line breaks).
– Select: Dropdown menus with custom options.
– Checkbox: Simple Yes/No toggles.
– Email: Validated email inputs.
– Phone: Phone number inputs.
– Number: Numeric inputs.

Flexible Layouts

Create a professional-looking checkout form by controlling the width of your custom fields:
– Full Width: Spans the entire row.
– Left / Right: Places two fields side-by-side (e.g., house number and street name).

Seamless Integration

Data collected from custom fields is fully integrated into your WooCommerce workflow:
– Admin Order View: Custom data appears in the “Billing” column of the order details screen.
– Order Emails: Fields are automatically added to New Order and Order Confirmation emails.
– Thank You Page: Customers see their submitted info on the “Order Received” and “View Order” pages.
– HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/h6-smart-checkout-fields-for-woocommerce/, or install it via the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → H6 Smart Checkout Fields to configure your fields.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the WooCommerce Checkout Block?

No. This plugin is designed for the standard (Classic) WooCommerce checkout shortcode. If you are using the Block-based checkout, these customizations will not appear.

Where can I see the custom field data?

Custom field data is displayed in:
1. The Admin Order Editor (under the Billing Address section).
2. The Order Received (Thank You) page for customers.
3. The Order Emails sent to both the administrator and the customer.

Can I reorder custom fields alongside core fields?

Yes. The settings page provides a unified table where you can drag and drop custom fields among the core billing and shipping fields to define the exact display order.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes, this plugin declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
